reading_1.theme: Calcineurin-NFAT driven cardiac hypertrophy
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are cardiomyocyte growth, sarcomere organization and cardiac muscle adaptation, framed as the hypertrophic outcome controlled by calcineurin-NFAT signalling.

reading_2.theme: Striated muscle hypertrophic growth and cell size regulation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are cardiomyocyte growth, sarcomere organisation and cardiac hypertrophic adaptation, framed as cell-size control of striated muscle in response to workload and activity.

shared: PI and PC transport between ER and Golgi membranes

reading_1.theme: Intermembrane lipid transfer and phospholipid turnover
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are non-vesicular transfer of phospholipids, glycolipids and ceramide-1-phosphate between membranes (e.g. PI/PC between ER and Golgi), framed as lipid distribution coupled to lysophospholipid and glycerophospholipid catabolism.

reading_2.theme: Membrane lipid transfer and bilayer organization
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are non-vesicular transfer of glycolipids, ceramide-1-phosphate and PI/PC between membranes by lipid transfer proteins, framed as inter-organelle lipid supply that sets membrane composition, complemented by flippase-driven transbilayer translocation and vesicular traffic in the additional pathways.

shared: collagen-activated tyrosine kinase receptor signaling pathway

reading_1.theme: Platelet activation and haemostasis
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe platelet adhesion via collagen/GPVI and GP1b-IX-V, activation, degranulation and aggregation, framed as haemostasis driven by thrombin, ADP, and thromboxane/prostacyclin receptor signalling in the additional set.

reading_2.theme: Platelet adhesion, activation and hemostasis
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are platelet adhesion to collagen (GPVI, GPIb-IX-V), activation, degranulation and aggregation, framed as primary hemostasis and coagulation whose VWF-ADAMTS13 variants underlie von Willebrand disorders.

bud elongation involved in lung branching

reading_1.theme: Lung development from branching to alveolar differentiation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are early lung organogenesis (epithelial bud branching, mesenchymal proliferation, lobe growth, pulmonary vasculature and perinatal ductus closure) as the morphogenetic groundwork preceding saccule formation and pneumocyte differentiation.

reading_2.theme: Lung development and branching morphogenesis
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are lung branching, growth and vascular development driven by epithelial-mesenchymal proliferation, framed within thoracic organogenesis including diaphragm and lung mesenchyme.

positive regulation of cell migration involved in sprouting angiogenesis

reading_1.theme: Angiogenesis and its positive and negative regulation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are pro-angiogenic VEGF-driven endothelial proliferation, migration and sprouting, framed against the negative regulators and wound-healing context of the additional set.

reading_2.theme: VEGF-driven sprouting angiogenesis
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are endothelial activation, proliferation, migration and branching in sprouting angiogenesis, framed as the response to VEGF and TGF-beta growth factor production.

shared: positive regulation of transcription of Notch receptor target
negative regulation of Notch signaling pathway

reading_1.theme: Notch intracellular domain transcriptional signalling and oncogenic activation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe NICD-driven Notch target gene transcription and its regulation, framed as the output that constitutively active NOTCH1 mutants and FBXW7 loss amplify in cancer.

reading_2.theme: Notch signalling
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe the transcriptional output of Notch intracellular domains and its regulation, framed as the nuclear endpoint of Notch receptor activation and oncogenic NOTCH1 mutant signalling.

reading_1.theme: Neutral amino acid transport and its disorders
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are SLC6A19 (Hartnup) and proton-coupled transport of neutral amino acids such as tryptophan, proline and glycine, framed as epithelial absorption and reabsorption of amino acids, with other SLC transporter disease variants added by the additional pathways.

reading_2.theme: Neutral amino acid and imino acid transport
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover plasma membrane transport of neutral amino acids, proline, glycine and tryptophan and Hartnup disorder, framed as renal/intestinal amino acid absorption whose defects cause aminoacidurias.

protein localization to phagophore assembly site

reading_1.theme: Selective autophagy and autophagosome regulation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are selective autophagy of ER, mitochondria, peroxisomes and nucleus and the regulation of autophagosome assembly and maturation (including ATG8 delipidation and depalmitoylation), framed as cargo-selective autophagic degradation, with UFMylation and nutrient or oxygen deprivation triggers added by the additional pathways.

reading_2.theme: Selective autophagy and autophagosome formation regulation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are autophagosome assembly and maturation control plus selective cargo autophagy (pexophagy, mitophagy, ER-phagy, nucleophagy), framed as the machinery of selective autophagic degradation including xenophagy and vacuolar targeting.

reading_2.theme: Growth factor-driven sprouting angiogenesis
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are VEGF and FGF receptor signalling promoting endothelial proliferation, chemotaxis, migration and vessel branching, framed as the pro-angiogenic sprouting program alongside endothelial activation, tube morphogenesis and vascular repair.

positive regulation of luteinizing hormone secretion

reading_1.theme: Ovarian folliculogenesis and gonadotropin control of ovulation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover ovarian follicle growth, oocyte meiotic maturation, ovulation, luteinization and FSH/LH secretion, framed as the hormonally controlled female reproductive cycle within broader gonadal and germ cell maturation.

reading_2.theme: Ovarian follicle development, ovulation and gonadotropin control
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are follicle growth, ovulation, luteinization, oocyte maturation and gonadotropin secretion, framed as the hormonally driven female reproductive cycle, with FSH/LH responses, estrous cycle and luteolysis in the additional pathways.

regulation of branching involved in ureteric bud morphogenesis

reading_1.theme: Ureteric bud and early kidney development
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe nephric duct and ureteric bud formation, elongation and branching, framed as the morphogenetic basis of kidney development.

reading_2.theme: Ureteric bud and early kidney morphogenesis
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are nephric duct and ureteric bud formation, elongation and branching that shape the mesonephros and kidney size, framed as the inductive morphogenesis regulated during metanephric development.

negative regulation of Notch signaling pathway

reading_1.theme: Notch signaling and transcriptional output
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover Notch target gene transcription and its negative regulation, framed as the canonical NICD-driven transcriptional program that becomes constitutive in NOTCH1 PEST/HD mutants.

reading_2.theme: Notch signalling to HES/HEY transcription
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are Notch-HLH target transcription and its regulation, framed as the nuclear transcriptional output of Notch receptors such as NOTCH3 and NOTCH4.

reading_1.theme: SLC anion transporters in mineralization and acid-base disorders
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are inorganic anion transport (bicarbonate, sulfate, phosphate, iodide, oxalate) and its transporter diseases, framed as ion handling that governs tissue mineralization and acid-base balance.

reading_2.theme: Inorganic anion transport and mineralization disorders
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe SLC-mediated transport of bicarbonate, phosphate, sulfate, iodide and oxalate and its genetic diseases (including enamel and ectopic calcification), framed as ion transport for acid-base balance and mineralization alongside proton exchange and pH regulation.

reading_1.theme: Renin-angiotensin control of blood pressure and volume
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are angiotensin signalling and renal sodium and urine-volume handling, framed as systemic blood pressure and volume regulation that counterbalances natriuretic-peptide cGMP signalling.

reading_2.theme: Renin-angiotensin and renal blood pressure regulation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are angiotensin signalling, renal sodium and urine excretion and natriuretic (guanylyl cyclase) counter-regulation, framed as renal-hormonal control of blood volume and systemic pressure, with vasopressin and vasomotor control in the additional pathways.

bone mineralization involved in bone maturation

reading_1.theme: Biomineralization of bone and teeth
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover positive and negative regulation of bone and enamel mineralization, dentinogenesis and tooth eruption, framed as the mineralized hard-tissue program of odontogenesis including dentin, enamel and cementum formation.

reading_2.theme: Bone and tooth mineralization and phosphate regulation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are regulation of bone, dentin and enamel mineralization including secreted phosphoprotein phosphorylation, framed as hard-tissue mineralization governed by FGF23-Klotho and PTH phosphate signalling.

Beta-oxidation of very long chain fatty acids

reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are acyl-CoA oxidase-dependent beta-oxidation of very-long-chain and branched (pristanoyl) fatty acids, medium/long-chain acyl-CoA handling and TYSND1 peroxisomal processing, framed as peroxisomal lipid catabolism, with VLCFA import (ABCD1/ALD) and peroxisome fission in the additional pathways.

reading_2.theme: Peroxisomal fatty acid oxidation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are beta-oxidation of very-long, branched and medium-chain fatty acids via acyl-CoA oxidase and peroxisomal protein processing, framed as peroxisomal lipid catabolism that also performs phytanate alpha-oxidation.

reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover TRAF6-, IRAK1- and RIP1-mediated recruitment of TAK1 and IKK complexes and NF-kappaB activation, framed as the signal-transduction core of MyD88- and TRIF-dependent Toll-like receptor innate immune signaling.

reading_2.theme: NF-kB activation via TLR and TNF receptor signalling
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are IKK complex recruitment through TLR-IRAK-TRAF6 and RIP1, framed as canonical NF-kB activation shared with TNFR1 ubiquitin-dependent signalling.

reading_1.theme: Nitrogen and ammonia disposal via the urea cycle
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are aspartate, glutamine, arginine and citrulline metabolism and ammonium homeostasis, framed as the nitrogen-handling inputs and intermediates of the urea cycle, whose ornithine transport defects cause hyperammonemia.

reading_2.theme: Nitrogen and ammonia handling via amino acid metabolism
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are glutamine, arginine/citrulline and aspartate metabolism in ammonium homeostasis, framed as nitrogen assimilation and disposal fed by glutamate-glutamine interconversion.

EGR2 and SOX10-mediated initiation of Schwann cell myelination

reading_1.theme: Myelination and axon regeneration in CNS and PNS
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are myelin formation and maintenance by Schwann cells and oligodendrocytes plus axon regrowth after injury, framed as glia-axon interactions governing nerve integrity and repair.

reading_2.theme: Glial myelination and axon regeneration after nervous system injury
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are glial (oligodendrocyte and Schwann cell) myelination, gliosis and injured-axon regrowth, framed as the nervous system's injury-and-repair response including growth-promoting and growth-inhibiting axonal signals.

reading_1.theme: Heavy metal response and metallothionein detoxification
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the MTF1-metallothionein response to metal ions (zinc, copper, mercury, iron), framed as heavy-metal detoxification including cadmium.

reading_2.theme: Cellular response to heavy metals
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are metallothionein- and MTF1-mediated detoxification responses to zinc, copper, mercury and iron, framed as a general metal-stress defence.

reading_1.theme: Insulin signalling and hepatic glycogen/glucose control
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the insulin receptor-IRS-AKT2 signalling cascade and its attenuation, framed as the control of glucose uptake and glycogen synthesis that also involves glucokinase and glycogenolysis.

reading_2.theme: Insulin signaling and glucose uptake regulation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are insulin receptor-IRS-AKT2 signalling and its attenuation, controlling glycogen synthesis and glucose import as the core of metabolic insulin sensitivity, with GLUT4 translocation and adiponectin signalling as effectors and modulators.

reading_1.theme: Drug and xenobiotic membrane transport (ADME)
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are SLCO and efflux transporter-mediated drug uptake and export, framed as the transport step of drug ADME including organic cation transport.

reading_2.theme: Drug and xenobiotic transport and disposition (ADME)
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe SLCO-mediated organic anion uptake, xenobiotic export and blood-brain barrier transport and the ADME of specific drugs, framed as the transporter-driven pharmacokinetic handling of drugs and xenobiotics.

reading_1.theme: Meiotic prophase I recombination in gametogenesis
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the core meiosis I machinery (programmed DSB formation, synapsis, recombination and its checkpoint) framed as the chromosomal engine of male and female gamete formation.

reading_2.theme: Meiotic recombination, synapsis and chromosome segregation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe meiotic prophase I events (DSB formation and repair, synapsis, telomere attachment, recombination resolution and checkpoints), framed as the recombination stage that establishes chiasmata and cohesion needed for correct meiotic chromosome segregation.

reading_2.theme: Renal electrolyte transport and cell volume regulation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe cation-chloride cotransporters, potassium channels and renal sodium/chloride/magnesium handling with Bartter and Gitelman syndromes, framed as ion transport underlying epithelial salt reabsorption and osmotic/cell volume regulation.

reading_1.theme: Nutrient and energy sensing by mTORC1
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the inputs and regulation of TORC1 signalling by amino acids (leucine), glucose and LKB1-AMPK energy status, framed as lysosome-based nutrient sensing (with cholesterol and rapamycin response as additional).

reading_2.theme: Nutrient and energy sensing by mTORC1
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are mTORC1 regulation by amino acids and LKB1-AMPK energy status, framed as the TSC-Rheb-gated growth control switch.

reading_2.theme: Actin dynamics for membrane ruffling, motility and macropinocytosis
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the actin polymerization, severing, capping and crosslinking machinery, used here to build ruffles and protrusions that drive macropinocytosis, podosomes and motility.

reading_2.theme: Nephron development from intermediate mesoderm
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are about metanephric mesenchyme differentiation, mesenchymal-to-epithelial transition and nephron patterning, framed as nephrogenesis alongside ureteric bud growth and progenitor survival.

reading_1.theme: Chondrocyte differentiation, growth plate and articular cartilage
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe cartilage condensation, chondrocyte proliferation, differentiation and hypertrophy and endochondral ossification, framed as cartilage development that builds both growth plates and joint/articular cartilage.

reading_2.theme: Chondrocyte differentiation and endochondral ossification

reading_2.theme: Stress, arousal and motivated behaviour
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are CRH and corticosterone stress responses, orexin-driven wakefulness, fear and motivated behaviours such as drinking, parental care and ethanol response, framed as neuropeptide and stress-hormone control of arousal and behaviour, extended to mating and aggression in the additional pathways.

reading_1.theme: M-CSF-driven osteoclastogenesis and bone resorption
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe osteoclast differentiation, fusion and bone resorption control, framed as a myeloid/macrophage fate driven by CSF1 and cytokine signalling.

reading_2.theme: Osteoclast formation and bone resorption
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are macrophage-to-osteoclast fusion, osteoclast differentiation and proliferation and control of bone resorption, framed as osteoclastogenesis in bone remodelling, with the additional pathways supplying DAP12 signalling and the membrane-fusion step of syncytium formation.

reading_2.theme: Excitatory and inhibitory postsynaptic assembly
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are GABAergic and glutamatergic postsynaptic clustering and excitation-inhibition balance, framed as neurexin-neuroligin-organized synapse formation.

reading_2.theme: Trans-synaptic adhesion in synapse assembly
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe neurexin-neuroligin, SALM and receptor phosphatase adhesion and pre/postsynaptic membrane assembly, framed as trans-synaptic organiser complexes that build synapses and tune excitatory transmission.

[untitled BTM module] These genes converge on receptor-proximal signalling that converts extracellular cues into changes in cell adhesion, migration and tissue remodelling. One arm is vascular and mesenchymal: endoglin acts as a TGF-beta superfamily co-receptor in endothelium, CCN2/CTGF and CRIM1 shape growth-factor availability in the matrix, and focal adhesion kinase with GAB1, PLCB1 and the Ral activator RGL1 relay integrin and growth-factor input to the cytoskeleton and to Ras-family GTPase output.

reading_1.theme: Leukocyte chemotaxis and homing to lymphoid organs
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe chemokine (CCR7) and S1P-guided migration of dendritic cells and lymphocytes into and within lymphoid tissues, with integrin-mediated adhesion as the supporting step.

reading_2.theme: Leukocyte chemotaxis, homing and lymphoid tissue organisation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are chemokine (CCR7/S1P)-driven lymphocyte and dendritic cell migration into lymphoid organs and lymph node development, framed within the broader leukocyte chemotaxis of the additional set.

regulation of endosome to plasma membrane protein transport

reading_1.theme: Endosomal recycling and Golgi membrane trafficking
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are endocytosis, endosome tubulation, receptor recycling and Golgi budding/secretion, framed as intracellular membrane trafficking that moves cargo between plasma membrane, endosomes and Golgi.

reading_2.theme: Endosomal recycling and Golgi membrane trafficking regulated by small GTPases
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the membrane trafficking steps themselves (endocytosis, endosome tubulation, recycling to the plasma membrane, Golgi budding and secretion), framed as the outputs controlled by Rab and ARF GTPase signalling.

reading_1.theme: B cell and plasma cell transcriptional signatures
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe B cell, memory B cell and plasma cell immunoglobulin gene modules and plasma cell differentiation, framed as the cellular identity signature of the B lineage within adaptive immune memory.

reading_2.theme: B cell activation toward plasma and memory cells
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are B cell, memory B and plasma cell signatures and plasma cell differentiation, framed as the antibody-producing outcome of germinal centre responses helped by Tfh cells.

reading_2.theme: Non-vesicular phospholipid transfer at ER membrane contact sites
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are PI synthesis and lipid transfer of PI/PC between the ER and other membranes, framed as non-vesicular lipid exchange at ER-plasma membrane/Golgi contact sites established by ER tethering.

reading_2.theme: Lipoylated mitochondrial 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase complexes
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the lipoylated 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase complexes (PDH, OGDH, OADH, glycine cleavage) sharing DLD, framed as mitochondrial 2-oxoglutarate and lysine/glycine catabolic metabolism.

reading_2.theme: Notch intracellular domain transcriptional signalling
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are NOTCH2/3/4 intracellular-domain-driven target transcription and its negative regulation, framed as a cell-fate switch used in Th2 differentiation and pancreatic development.

reading_2.theme: Branched-chain amino acid catabolism and organic acidaemias
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are mitochondrial catabolism of leucine, isoleucine, valine and related acyl-CoAs (with biotin-dependent carboxylases) and their inborn errors, the downstream steps after the BCKDH reaction defective in MSUD.

reading_2.theme: Cobalamin and biotin cofactor metabolism disorders
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are vitamin B12 uptake, transport and intracellular processing for MUT and MTR (methylmalonic acidemia, homocystinuria) linked to propionyl-CoA catabolism, framed as cofactor-dependent carboxylase/mutase metabolism alongside biotin recycling defects.

reading_1.theme: Hormonal GPCR regulation of islet secretion
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe glucagon, GLP-1, somatostatin, acetylcholine and fatty-acid GPCR signalling via adenylate cyclase, framed here as neuroendocrine regulation of islet insulin and glucagon secretion.

reading_2.theme: Hormone GPCR signalling controlling insulin secretion
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are adenylyl-cyclase-coupled hormone receptor signalling (GLP-1, glucagon, somatostatin, FFAR1, acetylcholine), framed as endocrine and nutrient GPCR control of insulin and pituitary hormone secretion.

shared: regulation of systemic arterial blood pressure by endothelin
negative regulation of receptor guanylyl cyclase signaling pathway
relaxation of vascular associated smooth muscle
regulation of systemic arterial blood pressure by norepinephrine-epinephrine
positive regulation of actin filament-based movement
negative regulation of systemic arterial blood pressure
regulation of vascular associated smooth muscle contraction

reading_1.theme: Vascular tone and blood pressure regulation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe NO-cGMP signalling, vasoconstriction and vasodilation, and renal sodium and fluid control of arterial pressure, framed as regulation of vascular smooth muscle contraction and relaxation.

reading_2.theme: Nitric oxide-cGMP control of vascular tone and blood pressure
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe cGMP-mediated regulation of vascular smooth muscle contraction, blood pressure and renal sodium excretion, framed as the downstream physiological effects of endothelial NO synthesis and signalling.

shared: optic cup morphogenesis involved in camera-type eye development
apoptotic process involved in blood vessel morphogenesis
negative regulation of lens fiber cell differentiation
embryonic retina morphogenesis in camera-type eye

reading_1.theme: Eye morphogenesis and retinal vascular development
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover camera-type eye tissue morphogenesis (lens, retina, cornea, iris) and Wnt-dependent retinal vasculature and barrier formation, framed as eye development broadened to optic nerve and adnexa.

reading_2.theme: Eye development: retinal vasculature, lens and ocular tissues
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are ocular morphogenesis and retinal vascular/barrier formation (Norrin-FZD4 signalling, hyaloid regression, lens and cornea development), framed as the tissue and vascular scaffold of the eye within which photoreceptor and retinal neuron differentiation proceed.

shared: regulation of branching involved in ureteric bud morphogenesis
positive regulation of epithelial tube formation
obsolete pattern specification involved in kidney development

reading_1.theme: Nephric duct and ureteric bud morphogenesis in kidney development
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover formation of intermediate mesoderm, the nephric/mesonephric duct and ureteric bud elongation and branching, framed as the early inductive morphogenesis of the urinary tract from which the ureteric bud is induced.

reading_2.theme: Kidney development: nephric duct, ureteric bud and nephrogenesis
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are nephric duct and ureteric bud formation and branching, framed as the inductive tissue that drives metanephric nephron development.

shared: Metabolism of ingested SeMet, Sec, MeSec into H2Se
Metabolism of ingested MeSeO2H into MeSeH

reading_1.theme: Sulfur and selenium amino acid catabolism
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are transsulfuration, cysteine and sulfur amino acid catabolism, taurine (alkanesulfonate) metabolism and the conversion of selenoamino acids to methylated selenide for excretion, framed as catabolism of sulfur and selenium amino acids, continued by sulfide oxidation in the additional pathways.

reading_2.theme: Sulfur amino acid and selenium compound metabolism
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are transsulfuration and sulfur amino acid catabolism together with selenium compound conversion to H2Se and methylated excretion, framed as one enzymatic machinery that processes both sulfur and selenium analogs.

shared: Nonsense Mediated Decay (NMD) enhanced by the Exon Junction Complex (EJC)
nuclear-transcribed mRNA catabolic process, no-go decay
Nonsense Mediated Decay (NMD) independent of the Exon Junction Complex (EJC)
PELO:HBS1L and ABCE1 dissociate a ribosome on a non-stop mRNA

reading_1.theme: Translation termination and mRNA surveillance decay
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are translation termination and ribosome-coupled mRNA quality control (nonsense-mediated, no-go and non-stop decay with stalled ribosome rescue), framed as surveillance of aberrant translation events.

reading_2.theme: Translation termination and mRNA surveillance with ribosome rescue
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe translation termination, nonsense-mediated and no-go decay, and rescue of stalled ribosomes, framed as translational quality control that also degrades the nascent peptide via ribosome-associated quality control.

shared: Activated NOTCH1 Transmits Signal to the Nucleus
Constitutive Signaling by NOTCH1 t(7;9)(NOTCH1:M1580_K2555) Translocation Mutant
positive regulation of transcription of Notch receptor target
negative regulation of Notch signaling pathway
NOTCH2 Activation and Transmission of Signal to the Nucleus
Constitutive Signaling by NOTCH1 HD Domain Mutants

reading_1.theme: Notch receptor signalling and its oncogenic dysregulation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are Notch intracellular-domain transcriptional signalling and its negative regulation and constitutive NOTCH1 mutants, framed as canonical Notch signalling that becomes oncogenic through NOTCH1 PEST/HD mutations and FBXW7 loss.

reading_2.theme: Notch signalling to the nucleus and transcriptional targets
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are Notch receptor intracellular-domain signalling and target gene transcription (including oncogenic NOTCH1 mutants), framed as the downstream output of receptor proteolysis and its use in developmental and T-cell fate decisions.

shared: microtubule nucleation by microtubule organizing center
positive regulation of protein localization to cell cortex
positive regulation of protein localization to centrosome
negative regulation of protein localization to microtubule
microtubule anchoring at microtubule organizing center

reading_1.theme: Microtubule organization, centrosome and cilium regulation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe microtubule nucleation, anchoring, severing and stability, tubulin polyglutamylation and centrosome positioning and cohesion, framed here as the centrosome-microtubule machinery that also governs centriole duplication and assembly or disassembly of the primary cilium.

reading_2.theme: Centrosome and microtubule control of spindle positioning
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are centrosome/MTOC positioning and microtubule dynamics (nucleation, anchoring, severing, polymerization control) used to orient and position the mitotic spindle for asymmetric cell division.

shared: regulation of myeloid dendritic cell activation
positive regulation of dendritic cell differentiation
negative regulation of dendritic cell differentiation
positive regulation of CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell proliferation
regulation of T cell activation via T cell receptor contact with antigen bound to MHC molecule on antigen presenting cell

reading_1.theme: Dendritic cell priming and T cell costimulation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are dendritic cell differentiation and activation plus T cell costimulation via MHC-TCR contact, framed as antigen-presenting-cell priming of CD4 T cell responses.

reading_2.theme: Dendritic cell-T cell interaction during antigen presentation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways frame the APC-T cell priming interface, covering dendritic cell differentiation and activation together with MHC-contact T cell costimulation and CD4 T cell proliferation, whose activated-DC and Th1 surface signatures appear among the additional sets.

shared: positive regulation of Ras protein signal transduction
Signalling to p38 via RIT and RIN

reading_1.theme: Ras-ERK-RSK signalling and its negative feedback
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the activating arm of Ras-MAPK signalling to RSK and p38, framed against phosphatase-mediated negative regulation of the ERK cascade.

reading_2.theme: RAS-MAPK signal transduction and its oncogenic mutants
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe RAS signal transduction to MAP2K/ERK, RSK and p38, framed as the downstream kinase cascade activated by SHC/SOS from growth factor receptors and constitutively by RAS mutants.

Defective SLC35A2 causes congenital disorder of glycosylation 2M (CDG2M)

Defective transport by SLC35A1 causes congenital disorder of glycosylation 2F (CDG2F)
Formation of the active cofactor, UDP-glucuronate

reading_1.theme: Nucleotide-sugar synthesis and protein glycosylation and its disorders
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the supply side of glycosylation: hexosamine/UDP-GlcNAc and sialic acid synthesis and Golgi nucleotide-sugar transport (with their CDG-type defects), feeding the N-glycan and GPI-anchor processing of the additional set.

reading_2.theme: Nucleotide sugar and sialic acid metabolism in glycosylation disorders
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are synthesis and Golgi transport of nucleotide sugars (UDP-GlcNAc, CMP-sialic acid) and their defects, framed as substrate supply for glycosylation in congenital glycosylation disorders.

shared: protein insertion into mitochondrial inner membrane
protein insertion into mitochondrial inner membrane from matrix

reading_1.theme: Mitochondrial respiratory chain complex assembly
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are complex III assembly and protein insertion into the inner mitochondrial membrane, framed as the biogenesis of OXPHOS complexes including complex I and ATP synthase assembly.

reading_2.theme: Mitochondrial respiratory chain complex assembly
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are complex III assembly and insertion of proteins into the mitochondrial inner membrane, framed as biogenesis of the respiratory chain that also includes complex IV and respirasome assembly.

shared: negative regulation of axon extension involved in axon guidance
SEMA3A-Plexin repulsion signaling by inhibiting Integrin adhesion

reading_1.theme: Axon guidance by semaphorin and netrin cues
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the Sema3A-driven repulsive guidance machinery (plexin/CRMP/PAK signalling, integrin inhibition, microtubule destabilization) that restrains and steers axon extension during nerve branching and innervation, complemented by netrin attraction and repulsion.

reading_2.theme: Axon guidance, repulsion and sprouting in peripheral neurons
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe Sema3A/plexin-mediated axon repulsion, CRMP and microtubule control, and axon extension and branching during innervation, framed here as the guidance machinery that also restrains or permits collateral sprouting and regeneration of peripheral (DRG, sympathetic) axons.

reading_1.theme: NGF-TRKA signalling to MAPK and transcription
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe TRKA activation via FRS2/ARMS and signalling to ERK5, p38 and CREB-dependent transcription, framed as neurotrophin receptor signalling through Ras-MAPK and PI3K/AKT.

reading_2.theme: Neurotrophin-TRKA signalling through MAPK/ERK5 cascades
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the NGF/TRKA receptor-proximal adaptors (FRS2, ARMS) and their transcriptional outputs (CREB, ERK5, p38), framed as the neurotrophin-specific entry points into the generic MAPK cascades listed as additional.

RORA,B,C and NR1D1 (REV-ERBA) regulate gene expression

Phosphorylation and nuclear translocation of the CRY:PER:kinase complex

reading_1.theme: Core circadian clock transcriptional feedback loop
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe the BMAL1:CLOCK-CRY:PER feedback loop, ROR/REV-ERB regulation and entrainment, framed as the molecular clock that times metabolic outputs like beta-cell, thermogenesis and glucocorticoid signalling.

reading_2.theme: Circadian clock machinery and metabolic outputs
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the BMAL1/CLOCK-CRY/PER transcriptional feedback loop, ROR/REV-ERB control, clock protein phosphorylation and degradation and light entrainment, framed as the core molecular clock that drives the PGC-1alpha, PPARalpha and heme metabolic outputs in the additional pathways.

shared: Formyl peptide receptors bind formyl peptides and many other ligands
positive regulation of monocyte chemotactic protein-1 production
formyl peptide receptor mediated neutrophil response

reading_1.theme: Myeloid chemotaxis via formyl peptide and chemokine receptors
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are GPCR-mediated chemoattraction of neutrophils, monocytes and macrophages, framed as recruitment of innate cellular defense.

reading_2.theme: Formyl peptide and chemokine-driven myeloid cell recruitment
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are formyl peptide receptor sensing and chemokine production driving neutrophil, monocyte and macrophage chemotaxis, framed as myeloid leukocyte recruitment to sites of inflammation.

shared: Caspase activation via Dependence Receptors in the absence of ligand
NFG and proNGF binds to p75NTR
NRIF signals cell death from the nucleus
regulation of glial cell apoptotic process
NF-kB is activated and signals survival

reading_1.theme: Neurotrophin receptor signalling for neuronal death and survival
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are p75NTR signalling (proNGF binding, regulated proteolysis, NRAGE/NRIF/JNK death signals, ceramide, NF-kB survival) and dependence-receptor caspase activation, framed as the apoptosis-versus-survival arm of neurotrophin signalling, set against the TrkA trophic signalling in the additional pathways.

reading_2.theme: p75NTR and Trk neurotrophin signalling in survival and death
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe proNGF/NGF processing, p75NTR-mediated death and survival signalling and dependence receptor apoptosis, framed as the cell-death and survival arm opposite TRKA-driven growth and differentiation signalling.

RPIA deficiency: failed conversion of R5P to RU5P

TALDO1 deficiency: failed conversion of SH7P, GA3P to Fru(6)P, E4P

reading_1.theme: Carbohydrate metabolism: fructose, pentose phosphate and gluconeogenesis
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe fructose, pentose phosphate and glucuronate/xylulose metabolism, gluconeogenesis and their inborn errors, framed as central sugar metabolism alongside glycolysis and galactose catabolism.

reading_2.theme: Pentose phosphate and hexose sugar interconversion
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are central sugar-phosphate interconversions (non-oxidative pentose phosphate, fructose, glucuronate, glycerol, gluconeogenesis) and their inborn errors, framed as feeding pyruvate/alanine-linked central metabolism.
